subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive Gateway protocol v4 response-envelope field for this fix?
rationale: The code path is a narrow bug fix with live proof, but adding a public envelope field can affect strict generated clients, so the compatibility posture is a maintainer-owned merge decision.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
options.body: Treat optional response metadata as a v4-compatible additive field and proceed once exact-head checks and mergeability are clean.

options.title: Version or relocate metadata
options.body: Require a protocol-versioned or payload-level metadata contract before merge if top-level additive fields are not acceptable for existing clients.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold this PR open until a gateway protocol owner chooses the long-term response metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
recommendation.body: Treat optional response metadata as a v4-compatible additive field and proceed once exact-head checks and mergeability are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the shared gateway request/protocol contract where Vincent Koc has recent feature-history ownership.
